title: Attempted assassination of Pedro II of Brazil
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Attempted assassination of Pedro II of Brazil", at revision 1365705070, opens: "On the night of 15 July 1889, an attempt was made on the life of Emperor Pedro II of Brazil in the Constituição Square in Rio de Janeiro.
Adriano Augusto do Valle, a Portuguese immigrant, shot at Pedro's carriage while shouting in praise of the republic.
The shots missed and do Valle escaped, though he was later captured." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q48869142, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1889 failed assassination on the Brazilian Emperor". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
